target.title: fix: confine Islo redirects to configured origin
target.body:
Closes #935.

Adds an Islo-specific redirect guard for the raw client, token client, and SDK client so credential-bearing requests stay on the configured scheme, host, and effective port. Covers same-origin redirects and cross-origin refusal with provider-client tests.

Proof requested by ClawSweeper:

```text
$ GOCACHE=/tmp/crabbox-go-cache go test ./internal/providers/islo -run 'TestIsloClientDeleteSandboxConfinesRedirects|TestIsloRedirectGuardUsesEffectiveOrigin|TestIsloClientDeleteSandboxHandlesEmptyAndMissing|TestIsloRawErrorsRedactSessionToken' -count=1 -v
=== RUN   TestIsloClientDeleteSandboxHandlesEmptyAndMissing
=== RUN   TestIsloClientDeleteSandboxHandlesEmptyAndMissing/success_codes
=== RUN   TestIsloClientDeleteSandboxHandlesEmptyAndMissing/error_status_surfaces
--- PASS: TestIsloClientDeleteSandboxHandlesEmptyAndMissing (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestIsloClientDeleteSandboxConfinesRedirects
--- PASS: TestIsloClientDeleteSandboxConfinesRedirects (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestIsloRedirectGuardUsesEffectiveOrigin
--- PASS: TestIsloRedirectGuardUsesEffectiveOrigin (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestIsloRawErrorsRedactSessionToken
=== RUN   TestIsloRawErrorsRedactSessionToken/delete
=== RUN   TestIsloRawErrorsRedactSessionToken/upload
=== RUN   TestIsloRawErrorsRedactSessionToken/create_share
=== RUN   TestIsloRawErrorsRedactSessionToken/list_shares
=== RUN   TestIsloRawErrorsRedactSessionToken/exec_stream
--- PASS: TestIsloRawErrorsRedactSessionToken (0.00s)
PASS
ok  github.com/openclaw/crabbox/internal/providers/islo 0.234s
```

`TestIsloClientDeleteSandboxConfinesRedirects` runs real `httptest` HTTP servers: the same-origin redirect reaches its target with authorization intact, while the cross-origin redirect returns `refusing islo redirect` and the redirected server is not hit. `TestIsloRedirectGuardUsesEffectiveOrigin` proves the default HTTPS port is allowed and a different explicit port is refused.
